{{Quote|Whoa&mdash;the only five-time winner of the Bao-Dur Science Prize is on Makeb? Are you saying he designed the ark?|Gez Addar|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>}}
The '''Bao-Dur Science Prize''' was a scientific prize awarded to members of the scientific community. By [[3638 BBY]], [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Juvard Illip Oggurobb]] had been the five-time winner of the Science Prize. It was presumably named after [[Bao-Dur]], due to his recognition as a pioneering scientist and engineer.
